title: pp.fft-profile~
description: `pp.fft-profile~` is an esoteric spectral denoiser/vocoder that filters one signal using a spectral mask retrieved from a second signal, outputting both the masked signal and the residual. Its FFT block size and overlap can be set by creation arguments (defaults: 1024 and 4), and its GUI supports learning, freezing, and saving or recalling up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
